notes.title: Island Maps Update
notes.notes:
With a final push, I've managed to add a new map type to the final release version. Islands - while this slows inital contact between races, it means a less full map with strategic resources becoming ever more important.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35421654/530943dcdf0ff3390e23741e1cd4bb3d2028fc9c.png

notes.title: Patch 0.8.6
notes.notes:
Upgraded NWJS to 4.0 with Chromium 76
 Completely reworked how settlers and bulders search for targets.
 Added Mana stones to be mined.
 Reworked map sized.
 Balanced mana production in mid game.
 Fixed issues with settlers walking off map.
 All unit now treansition to boats at sea.
 Preachers no longer convert empty tiles.
 Enemy players will now reach out to take special locations.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.1 (Tutorial Update)
notes.notes:
This patch adds a short manual to the game as well as updating the core nwjs scripts.

Other Fixes:


 Enemy ubilders no longer defaul to tile 0 on a failed search to find a plot.
 'Special' plots now occur more frequently.
 'Special' plots will no longer spawn close to cities.
 Necromancer towers now only spawn in wastelands.
 The Arctic God no longer spams defensive forts.
